subject.title: ci(release): update Kova model pin files

question: Should the release branch receive the complete compatible Kova integration now, or retain its previous pin until that backport is ready?
rationale: The protected release-branch PR cannot safely land its current partial pin, while choosing the compatible evaluator revision or matching evidence backport requires release-owner judgment.

options.title: Complete the backport
options.body: Backport deterministic full-report selection and a compatible Kova runner/evidence contract, then land after the exact-head lane passes.

options.title: Retain the previous pin
options.body: Defer this Kova update and keep the release branch unchanged until the full compatibility backport is ready.

recommendation.title: Complete the backport
recommendation.body: Backport deterministic full-report selection and a compatible Kova runner/evidence contract, then land after the exact-head lane passes.

likelyOwner.reason: The history ties this person to the current-main workflow revision, adjacent LTS repair, and proposed Kova revision.
